parties: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited; RPSG Ventures Limited
headline: Lebnitze Real Estates discloses substantial acquisition in RPSG Ventures under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in RPSG Ventures Limited. The disclosure triggers mandatory reporting under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a threshold crossing in equity stake.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings mark the entry point for public scrutiny of acquisitions crossing the 25% threshold; advisors must confirm whether a full open offer obligation is triggered and the acquirer's timeline to mandatory tender.
detail: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in RPSG Ventures Limited. Under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, this disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses specified thresholds (typically 25% of voting capital or control). The filing establishes the public record and triggers calculation of open offer obligations, if applicable. No consideration amount or final stake percentage is disclosed in the NSE filing summary.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when substantial acquisition thresholds are crossed; filing must be made within 4 trading days of crossing threshold.
Definition of 'acquirer' and 'acquisition of shares'; determines who must file and which acquisitions trigger the Code.
Open offer obligations triggered upon crossing 25% threshold in a listed company; acquirer must typically make an open offer to acquire minimum 26% additional shares.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 - Section 4 (definition of 'subsidiary'); Section 188 (related party transactions)
framework.note: Post-acquisition, control relationships and related-party transaction reporting will be triggered if control changes hands.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Regulation 30
framework.note: Material event disclosure on stock exchange; change of control or substantial stake acquisition must be disclosed within 24 hours.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 10 (escrow account), Regulation 11 (financing disclosures)
framework.note: Acquirer must disclose source of funds and maintain escrow account if required; critical for understanding deal financing structure.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 - Section 47(v)(d), Schedule VI (Liberalised Remittance Scheme)
framework.note: If foreign acquirer, withholding tax and FDI approvals under Schedule I may be triggered.

conditions: Crossing of 25% or other specified threshold in RPSG Ventures Limited equity

approvals: SEBI Takeover Code compliance clearance (via public offer process if triggered)
